join_assessment.question: can register records be matched to individual OSM building ways?
join_assessment.obstacle: The register is keyed by 지번 (bun/ji). OSM here carries 도로명 style addr:street and addr:housenumber for 5.9% and 5.3% of ways respectively, which is a different addressing system, and only 17 of the 456 buildings that actually need a height have a house number at all.
join_assessment.consequence: Per-building attribution is not the realistic first use. The population statistics are: the register gives the true height and floor-count distribution for 여의도동, which is exactly the kind of quantity the 12.0 m default and the nine assumed floor heights are standing in for.

stronger_join_candidate.why: It publishes building footprints already joined to 세움터 register attributes, which would allow a spatial match to OSM footprints instead of an address match. Not assessed in detail yet.

blocking_reasons: no register response is recorded, so height and floor count remain unavailable and the facade dimensions stay at grade D
next_evidence_gate: Issuing the service key is the project owner's action; the dataset auto-approves, is free and carries no use-scope restriction. Once a response is recorded, heit / grndFlrCnt supplies floor-to-floor heights from two official values and replaces the grade-D assumptions.
